verdict: confirmed-scarce — no primary source corroborates the USD 656.2M figure; the sole originator is Grand View Research (auto-aggregator); a bottom-up cross-check using audited Indonesian hospital and clinical-lab filings produces a plausible but much-wider range of USD 160–260M for corporate/preventive MCU specifically, casting doubt on GVR's USD 656.2M as potentially representing a broader diagnostic-services definition rather than MCU alone
primary_number: USD 656.2M (GVR only — unverified); bottom-up cross-check with verified IDX filings suggests USD 160–260M if MCU is scoped narrowly, or up to USD 337M if the full independent-clinical-lab market is included
methodology_note: GVR provides no disclosed primary methodology. Their figure (USD 656.2M, CAGR 9.9%) is reproduced verbatim across competitor aggregators (Mordor Intelligence, IMARC, Ken Research) with no independent corroboration. A bottom-up sanity check using audited IDX filings: (a) Prodia Widyahusada (PRDA) — Indonesia's largest independent clinical lab with 40.1% segment market share — reported IDR 2,222 billion (USD 141M) total revenue in 2023 and IDR 1,598 billion in 9M2024 (est. FY2024 IDR 2,131 billion = USD 135M); this implies the total independent-lab sector is ~USD 336M. (b) Corporate-client segment of Prodia was 15.7% of revenue (the proxy for corporate MCU demand), implying ~USD 21M from Prodia alone in MCU-adjacent corporate work. (c) Hospital-based MCU at major private groups (MIKA IDR 4,874B, SILO IDR 12,510B, others) at 5–8% MCU share adds USD 111–177M. (d) Indonesia total health expenditure per WHO Indonesia Health Accounts 2024 was IDR 639.9 trillion (USD 40.5B); GVR's USD 656.2M would equal 1.62% of total health spend, which is plausible in principle but cannot be traced to a primary source. Kemenkes Profil Kesehatan 2023 PDF was inaccessible (returned empty via markitdown); BPS Health Statistics 2023 similarly returned no MCU segment data. No Frost & Sullivan, McKinsey, Deloitte, PwC, or ADB/World Bank primary report on Indonesia MCU market size was located.
